lineage.description: Registry-based compilation of internally displaced persons (IDPs) and mass displacement events in Colombia spanning 2012-2019. Data aggregates reported displacement incidents and affected population counts from humanitarian monitoring, providing post-event impact records of population displacement across multiple hazard types.
